title: Missed Installation Slot Charge on Lapsed Tire Orders — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
A missed-slot charge is taken off the refund on a lapsed Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty order, following the order's installation bookings.

- **Missed slots** are every booking made for the order when the latest booked appointment date is before today, and every booking but the latest when it is not.
- One missed slot costs $10.00; two or more cost $20.00; none costs nothing.

| Bookings on the order | Latest appointment date | Missed slots | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | before today | 1 | $10.00 |
| 1 | today or later | 0 | $0.00 |
| 2 | today or later | 1 | $10.00 |
| 3 | before today | 3 | $20.00 |
| none | — | 0 | $0.00 |

(All rows are hypothetical orders.)
